mapper.select: select PRF.FEEDBACK_ID, PRF.RISK_WARNING_ID, PRF.FEEDBACK_DATE, PRF.RISK_LEVEL, PRF.RISK_INFO, PRF.FEEDBACK_INFO, PRF.FEEDBACK_OPINION, hba.plm_attachment_id, hba.document_name, hba.plm_source_type, hba.plm_id, ( SELECT wm_concat(sf.file_name) FROM sys_attachment sa, sys_file sf WHERE hba.plm_attachment_id = sa.source_key AND sa.source_type = hba.plm_source_type AND sa.attachment_id = sf.attachment_id ) file_name, hba.description from PLM_RISK_FEEDBACK PRF LEFT JOIN plm_attachment hba ON hba.plm_attachment_id = PRF.plm_attachment_id where PRF.RISK_WARNING_ID = #{riskWarningId} order by PRF.last_update_date asc

select ( SELECT sf.file_path FROM sys_attachment sa, sys_file sf WHERE hba.plm_attachment_id = sa.source_key AND sa.source_type = hba.plm_source_type AND sa.attachment_id = sf.attachment_id ) file_path, ( SELECT sf.file_id FROM sys_attachment sa, sys_file sf WHERE hba.plm_attachment_id = sa.source_key AND sa.source_type = hba.plm_source_type AND sa.attachment_id = sf.attachment_id ) file_id, ( SELECT wm_concat(sf.file_name || sf.file_suffix) FROM sys_attachment sa, sys_file sf WHERE hba.plm_attachment_id = sa.source_key AND sa.source_type = hba.plm_source_type AND sa.attachment_id = sf.attachment_id ) file_name, hba.description from PLM_RISK_FEEDBACK PRF LEFT JOIN plm_attachment hba ON hba.plm_attachment_id = PRF.plm_attachment_id where PRF.RISK_WARNING_ID = #{riskWarningId} order by PRF.last_update_date asc
